order.title: Order from Carrefour
order.lead: The basket fills itself from this menu, on a paired browser.
order.neverPays: Ordering and paying stay yours: nothing is confirmed automatically.
order.howItWorks: The fill is done by a Chrome extension on a computer you pair once. Keep that Chrome open — it is what fills the basket.
order.noBrowser: No paired browser yet, so nothing can fill the basket — a run would wait forever. Pair a browser to start the fill.
order.waitingHint: Open Chrome on a paired machine and the run starts by itself.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.intro: Your basket fills itself from your menu. Three steps once, then it is automatic.

install.title: Install the extension
install.desc: On the computer you keep open: it is what fills the basket.
install.hint: Once installed, this step ticks itself off.

carrefour.title: Sign in to Carrefour
carrefour.desc: Open Carrefour and sign in if needed. The extension checks your session and ticks the step.

setup.ready: All set! Compose your week, then “Fill my basket” from Shopping.

error.queue: The request did not go through. Try again in a moment.

device.title: Paired browsers
device.lead: A paired browser may fill your basket. The token is shown once only.
device.label: Name for this browser
device.tokenHint: Paste it into the extension, then close this. It will never be shown again.
device.extensionHere: Extension detected on this browser: pairing happens on its own, nothing to paste.
device.autoPaired: This browser is paired. Nothing to paste into the extension.

carrefour.title: Carrefour account
carrefour.lead: Open Carrefour in a tab: if you are not signed in, sign in there (no password goes through this site). The extension checks your session and updates the state.
carrefour.unknown: Not known yet: open Carrefour on a paired browser and it updates on its own.

install.title: Install the extension
install.lead: The basket is filled by a small extension, installed once on the browser you keep open. Then pair that browser below.
install.edgeNote: On Edge, use the Chrome link — it is the same engine underneath.
install.thenPair: Once installed, come back here and click “Pair a browser” below: the extension configures itself, nothing to paste.

cost.title: What it costs
cost.overThreshold: Above your warning threshold. Check the quantities before paying.
cost.belowMinimum: Below the order minimum: this much is still missing before it can be ordered.
cost.thresholdHint: Leave empty to never be warned.

slots.title: When to deliver
slots.lead: Tick when a delivery suits you. With nothing ticked, no slot is booked.
slots.none: Nothing ticked: the basket will be filled, but you pick the slot yourself.

push.title: Tell me on this phone
push.lead: A notification when the basket is ready, or when the run stopped.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings.
